found.name: AI and Generative AI library guide
found.quote: This guide explains how you can use it appropriately and transparently in your studies and introduces some tools that can help you.

found.name: Digital Skills Hub LinkedIn Learning training
found.quote: The Digital Skills Hub also contains support for using AI, including LinkedIn Learning training.
There is further information and University guidance on using Generative AI on The Hub (for staff) and MyCranfield (for students).
